title: Stairway to Heaven Carriage - Vacation Rental in Rosemary Beach,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… "Stairway to Heaven Carriage," a charming 1-bedroom home in the heart of Rosemary Beach, just steps from the Coquina Pool and a 2-minute walk to the beach. Enjoy a well-equipped kitchenette, inviting interiors with a cozy Queen nook and 2 Twin loft, plus a wrap-around porch with seating to relax and unwind outdoors soaking up ocean breeze and serene views. Perfect for beach lovers seeking the ultimate 30A getaway! Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Wrap-around Porch with Seating - Relax and unwind outdoors.Steps to Coquina Pool - Just a 1-minute walk from your door to ultimate relaxation.Beach Access with Bathrooms - Stroll to the beach in under 2 minutes.Heart of Rosemary Beach - Minutes to boutique shops, dining, and tennis courts.Cozy Interiors - Includes a main living area, kitchenette, Queen nook and loft with 2 Twins for kids.Includes 2 Bikes - Explore 30A with easeEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"Wonderful weekend getaway for our family! Located right around the corner from the pool and beach access." – Jacquelyn E.⭐"Great little place. Very short walk to the beach and town center; we enjoyed our stay tremendously." – Wes L.⭐"Perfect location for pool and beach access! Clean and cozy spot for our small family vacation." – Carol J.*** LIVING AREA ***Upon entering "Stairway to Heaven Carriage," you'll immediately feel at home. The open-concept living area is both inviting and functional, featuring comfortable furnishings and bright decor that reflects the beauty of 30A. Unwind after a day outdoors on the plush sofa while watching your favorite shows on the flat-screen TV.Spacious and well-lit living areaFlat-screen TV and cozy sofaOpen design perfect for relaxing*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The compact yet fully functional kitchenette in "Stairway to Heaven Carriage" is perfect for whipping up quick meals or snacks before hitting the beach. With all the essentials like a four-burner stove, dishwasher, and hotel-style mini fridge, you’ll have everything you need for your culinary convenience. Although the mini fridge does not include a freezer, there is an ice maker in the garage available for guest use.Four-burner electric stove for easy meal prepConvenient dishwasher and mini fridge (no freezer)Quaint dining nook ideal for 2*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Get the rest you deserve in the comfortable sleeping arrangements provided at "Stairway to Heaven Carriage." The main level features a cozy queen bed, and the loft offers two twin beds, making it ideal for families or friends.1st Floor:Common Area Nook: Queen-sized bed with soft linens.Full Bathroom: Convenient shared bathroom with shower/tub combo.Loft Level:Cozy Loft with 2 twin beds, perfect for kids or extra guests.*** COMMUNITY AMENITIES & LOCATION ***Nestled in the heart of Rosemary Beach, "Stairway to Heaven Carriage" offers unbeatable access to top attractions and amenities. Relax at the Coquina Pool, just a 1-minute walk away, or enjoy nearby tennis courts, boutique shops, and delicious dining options like The Pearl’s Havana Beach Bar.Coquina Pool (1-minute walk)Beach access with restrooms (2-minute walk)Tennis courts and Pro Shop (3-minute walk)Rosemary Beach Town Center, Heated Sky Pool and Fitness Center (4-minute walk)Rosemary Beach Community: Beachside destination with award-winning architectureRacquet Club – one of the world’s top 75 tennis spotsMultiple parks & greens with playgrounds, a splash pad, butterfly park, and hidden boardwalks with fountains4 RESORT POOLSBarbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflowSky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool & playground nearby*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 2 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 4526STRO #: STR-221806
